{{Quote|Sorry we're late, Commander. We were putting down an insurrection on Yalbec Prime when your comm came in. Had a few unforeseen… complications.|[[Clone Sergeant]] [[Hunter]] of Clone Force 99 apologizes to [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody]] for being late|<ref name="BB">{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Yalbec Prime''' was a location in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Timelines" /> During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic|Republic's]] [[Clone Force 99]], an elite group of [[clone trooper]]s, were sent to put down an [[Insurrection on Yalbec Prime|insurrection]] on Yalbec Prime, but complications arose when a member of the group, known as [[Wrecker]], cut off the [[Yalbec queen stinger|stinger]] of a [[Yalbec]] [[Unidentified Yalbec queen|queen]]. Various [[Gender|male]] Yalbec then tried to mate with them, but the group eventually managed to leave Yalbec Prime and travel to the [[planet]] [[Anaxes]] for their next [[Battle of Anaxes|mission]].<ref name="BB" />

During the [[Imperial Era]], [[Crime lord|crime boss]] [[Sorc Tormo]] of the [[Haxion Brood]] used the phrase "uglier than mating season on Yalbec Prime" while commentating on combat in his [[fighting pit]] on the Haxion Brood's [[asteroid]] stronghold [[Ordo Eris]].<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yalbec Prime was first mentioned in "[[The Bad Batch (episode)|The Bad Batch]],"<ref name="BB" /> the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[February 21]], [[2020]].<ref name="SW.com final">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-final-season|text=The Final Season of ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Begins!}}</ref> The episode originally aired as an unfinished story reel on [[April 17]], [[2015]], at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]],<ref name="Anaheim Announcement">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-bad-batch-4-episode-arc-coming-to-star-wars-celebration|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' "Bad Batch" 4-Episode Arc Coming to ''Star Wars'' Celebration|nolive=1}}</ref> and later on [[StarWars.com]] on [[April 29]] as part of [[The Clone Wars Legacy|''The Clone Wars'' Legacy]] multimedia project.<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-bad-batch-recon|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' "Bad Batch" Recon|nolive=1}}</ref>

The spelling of the bodies' name was confirmed in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />
